kv12.3:1.3: Sukhavedanīyo, dukkhavedanīyo, adukkhamasukhavedanīyo, sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, phassena sampayutto, vedanāya sampayutto, saññāya sampayutto, cetanāya sampayutto, cittena sampayutto sārammaṇo,
kv12.3:1.4: atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:1.6: Nanu na sukhavedanīyo, na dukkhavedanīyo --pe-- anārammaṇo, n' atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā -- pe--paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:1.8: Hañci na sukhavedanīyo, na dukkhavedanīyo --pe-- anārammano, n' atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, no vata re vattabbe
kv12.3:2.1: Phasso vipāko, phasso sukhavedanīyo --pe-- sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:2.3: Saddo vipāko, saddo sukhavedanīyo --pe-- sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:3.1: Saddo vipāko, saddo na sukhavedanīyo --pe-- anārammaṇo, n' atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:3.3: Phasso vipāko, phasso na sukhavedanīyo --pe-- anārammaṇo, n' atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv12.3:4.5: "So tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannatā vipulattā brāhmassaro hoti karavīkabhāṇī ti."
kv12.3:4.8: Tena hi saddo vipāko ti Saddo vipāko ti kathā 1.
